SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. I. Special Branch D. Station
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. I. REGISTRY No. Branch D. Station Date April 5 1940）

Subject. S. Shidlovski - applicant on behalf of a group of Russians
for permission to enter and settle in North Borneo.
Made by. D.S.I. Laklaevsky Forwarded by J. I. Crawford.

The applicant Stepan Shidlovski, Russian
of Polish origin, aged 26 years, is an aircraft pilot
by profession and arrived here from Sandakan, North
Borneo in February of 1940, and is at present staying
with his parents at 532-C. Cathay Flats, Avenue
Joffre.

The applicant, upon graduating from the
Aviation School in Hongkong in 1936, became acquainted
with Dr. Stookes, a well-known surgeon and
superintendent of several hospitals in North Borneo,
who was then visiting Hongkong and as a result of this
acquaintance, he obtained a position as a private
air-pilot to Dr. Stookes and subsequently left
Hongkong for North Borneo in company of Dr. Stookes in whose
employ he has been for the last four years. At the
beginning of 1939, applicant's father Appolinary
Shidlovski visited him in North Borneo and it was then
arranged between Dr. Stookes and applicant's father
that the latter take up the lease on the Doctor's farm
where he will conduct farming and a cheese
manufacturing enterprise.

In February of this year both the
applicant and his father returned to Shanghai in
order to organise a group of settlers experienced
in farming. They contacted the Paschenko family,
experienced cheese manufacturing people, who own
a cheese manufacturing enterprise in Tsingtao under

特别情报科 D 站
报告
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别情报科登记处 No. D 站 日期 1940年4月5日）

事由：S. Shidlovski —— 代表一群俄国人申请获准进入并定居北婆罗洲。
撰写人：特别情报科督察 Laklaevsky 转呈人：J. I. Crawford。

申请人 Stepan Shidlovski，俄籍，波兰裔，现年26岁，职业为飞机驾驶员，于1940年2月从北婆罗洲山打根抵达此处，目前与其父母同住于霞飞路国泰公寓532-C号。

申请人于1936年毕业于香港航空学校后，结识了当时正在访问香港的 Dr. Stookes（音译），此人是北婆罗洲多家医院的知名外科医生兼院长。基于这层关系，他获得了担任 Dr. Stookes 私人飞行员的职位，随后随 Dr. Stookes 离开香港前往北婆罗洲，并在其麾下受雇已达四年之久。1939年初，申请人的父亲 Appolinary Shidlovski 前往北婆罗洲探望他，当时 Dr. Stookes 与申请人的父亲商定，由后者承租医生的农场，从事农业及奶酪制造业务。

今年二月，申请人及其父亲均返回上海，旨在组织一批具有农业经验的移民团体。他们联系了 Paschenko 家族，该家族是经验丰富的奶酪制造者，在青岛拥有一家名为

the name of "Paschenko Brothers" who agreed to go
to North Borneo and start a cheese manufacturing
enterprise on Dr. Stookes' farm.

Out of the Paschenko family only
Vladimir Leovich Paschenko, the youngest son, is
at present in Shanghai, the other members of the
family being in Tsingtao to wind up their business
there.

The Paschenko family first came to
Shanghai from Manchuria in 1938 and after a short
period here departed for Tsingtao where they started
a cheese manufacturing business.

During their short sojourn in Shanghai
none of these persons came to the notice of
Municipal Police in connection with any political or
other activities of an undesirable character.

D. C. (Special Branch)

“Paschenko Brothers”的奶酪制造企业，他们同意前往北婆罗洲，在 Dr. Stookes 的农场上开办奶酪制造业务。

Paschenko 家族中，目前仅幼子 Vladimir Leovich Paschenko 在上海，其他家庭成员仍在青岛处理结束当地业务的事宜。

Paschenko 家族于1938年首次从满洲来到上海，在此短暂停留后前往青岛，并在那里开始了奶酪制造生意。

在他们短暂逗留上海期间，这些人均未因任何政治活动或其他不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

Sandakan, 4th March 1940.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that an
application for permission for the following persons
to enter and settle in North Borneo has been received
from Mr. S. Shidlovski, at present residing at
832-C Cathay Flats, Avenue Joffre, Shanghai:-
    Appolinary Anthony Shidlovski (aged 51 years),
        father of the applicant;
    Peter Ivanovich Paschenko ( aged 51 years), his
        wife Tatyana Artemovna (aged 51 years)
        and daughter Olga (aged 12 years);
    Pavel Petrovich Paschenko (aged 29 years), elder
        son of the above, and his wife Viera
        Ivanovna (aged 29 years);
    Vladimir Petrovich (aged 21 years), second son of
        the above, and his wife Viera Victorovna
        (aged 20 years).

2. Both the applicant and his father are
known in Sandakan where they have recently resided,
but nothing is known of the other persons named.
Before further consideration is given to the applic-
ation I wish to satisfy myself that these persons
are not undesirable, and I should, therefore, be
most grateful if you could cause enquiries to be
made as to whether anything is known against any
of these persons, or whether there are other reasons
why it would be undesirable to entertain their
application for permission to settle here.

            I have the honour to be,
                    Sir,
            Your most obedient servant,
                (Sd) C.R. Smith
His Britannic Majesty's Consul-General,        Governor.
    British Consulate-General,
        SHANGHAI.

先生：

谨此通知阁下，已收到目前居住于上海霞飞路国泰公寓832-C号的 S. Shidlovski 先生提交的关于允许下列人员进入并定居北婆罗洲的申请：
    Appolinary Anthony Shidlovski（51岁），
        申请人之父；
    Peter Ivanovich Paschenko（51岁），其
        妻 Tatyana Artemovna（51岁）
        及女儿 Olga（12岁）；
    Pavel Petrovich Paschenko（29岁），上述人之长
        子，及其妻 Viera
        Ivanovna（29岁）；
    Vladimir Petrovich（21岁），上述人之次
        子，及其妻 Viera Victorovna
        （20岁）。

2. 申请人及其父亲在山打根为人所知，他们最近曾居住于此，但对其他列名人员则一无所知。在进一步审议该申请之前，我希望确认这些人员并非不受欢迎之人，因此，如蒙阁下安排调查是否有任何不利于这些人员的记录，或者是否有其他理由表明不应受理他们在此定居的许可申请，我将不胜感激。

            谨此致意，
                    先生，
            您最顺从的仆人，
                （签名） C.R. Smith
大英陛下驻上海总领事，        总督。
    英国驻上海总领事馆，
        上海。
